english: When he came home weeping, We wept bitterly, And when he went away We all made peace.

prakrit: नाऊण य वुत्तन्तं सव्वं अन्नुन्नवज्जरिज्जन्तं,अक्कोसन्ति बहुविहं सुमङ्गलं नयरनारीओ
english: From the moment they hear the name They forward everything to the next day. There are so many of them That they make perfect lovers.

prakrit: एयस्स पडउ विज्जू सुत्तो मा एस बुज्झउ पावो,निद्दोसोवि धणवई अवहरिओ जेण पावेण
english: Come, fall asleep widjo, do not sleep on this day. For those who sleep soundly Desire the blessings of God in return.

prakrit: हा! पाव! किं न आसी खयरीओ तुह सरूवजुत्ताओ,मुद्धाए वसुमईए जेण तुमे खण्डियं सीलं?
english: Ah! Paav! Aren't you afraid that the axe will fall on you, Foolish girl, Because you sealed the block?

prakrit: ता पाव! इण्हि पावसु अणज्जकज्जम्मि निरय! निल्लज्ज!,नियदुच्चेट्ठियसरिसं इहपरलोए फलं कडुयं
english:
Your fault! You have done nothing wrong! Stop it! The fruit is bitter now, For all the hard work put in by your enemies.
एयं न होइ जोग्गं नामं एयस्स दुट्ठचरियस्स!,पावो अमङ्गलो एस जेण एयं कयं पावं	It cannot be so, my name is Aeschylacharias!, but rather a sin which has led to such a fate.

prakrit: कन्नकडुएहिं एवं असब्भवयणेहिं तेण लोएणं,अक्कोसिओ स बहुहा सुदीणवयणो तहिं वरओ
english: A man of many talents, With eyes that are hard of hearing And ears that are unable to hear, Is a blessing in disguise.

prakrit: तेणेव देवेण तहिं मायावित्ताइं रोवमाणाइं,अणुसासियाइं सम्मं तुण्हिक्काइं तु जायाइं
english: Then the gods will come crying out for you in such a way That you will have to go to your senses.

prakrit: तत्तो सुरेण भणिया मुञ्चन्ती थूलअंसुयपवाहं,भद्दे! वसुमइ! इण्हिं को तुह हिययस्स उच्छाहो?
english:
That wretched girl, Sniffing the tears welling up in her eyes, Looks awry! It's your turn! Who is going to explain your situation to me?
अह तीए वज्जरियं लज्जाए समोणमन्तवयणाए,जं किञ्चि तुम सामिय! आइससि तहिं समुच्छाहो	Ah, the embarrassment you cause when you are alone! You look just as you did when you arrived!
भणियं सुरेण सुन्दरि! जइ एवं ता करेसु पव्वज्जं,जिणवरभणियं धम्मं कम्ममहाकन्दकोद्दालं	My dear, Suren Sundari! Go and do it yourself, Lord! For if you desire to live, You will have to sacrifice your life In the arbor of dharma And karma's arrow.

prakrit: जइवि हु सुन्दरि! तुमए अयाणमाणाए एयमायरियं,तहवि हु इमस्स ओसहं होउ पव्वज्जा
english: How lovely you are! You have added so much beauty to my life, And yet I am so full of pride."

prakrit: तत्तो य वसुमईए तहत्ति बहु मन्नियं तयं वयणं,महईए विभूईए नियबन्धवअणुमया ताहे
english: So long as I live, So long may my husband live, If I live my life In peace With my parents.

prakrit: तत्थेव य नयरीए सुहम्मनामस्स पवरसूरिस्स,मयहरियाए बहुविहसाहुणिगणसेवियकमाए
english: At that moment the eyes of the women burst into laughter, When they hear the name of the beloved they rejoice very much."

prakrit: चन्दजसानामाए समप्पिया सुरवरेण सयमेव,तीएवि य आगमविहिणा दिन्ना दिक्खा वसुमईए
english: When the moon is full, With sweet fragrance it stays put; When it is half full, It vanishes without a trace.

prakrit: सोवि सुमङ्गलखयरो गुरुरोसेणावि तेण देवेण,दट्ठूण दीणवयणो न मारियो कहवि हु दयाए
english: She does not rejoice when, beside her husband's anger, she gives to others what she would not kill if she saw them.

prakrit: नेऊण माणुसुत्तरगिरिस्स परओ स उज्झिओ वरओ,अह सो तियसो पत्तो निययविमाणम्मि वेगेण
english: Though he had no more work in the fields, He was ready for it. So, too, did he manage to speed up the ship's voyage."

prakrit: सावि हु वसुमइअज्जा समिईगुत्तीसु सम्ममुवउत्ता,सज्झायज्झाणजुत्ता उज्जुत्ता विणयकरणम्मि
english: I will never forget how my lover kissed me, When I tried to kiss his lips And his lips quivered.

prakrit: पुव्वसयसहस्साइं बहूणि काऊण पवरसामन्नं,संलेहणाए सम्मं झोसित्ता निययदेहं तु
english: With great difficulty Bridegroom's daughter - in - law answered," "You will meet the fate which awaits you."

prakrit: अणुरायवसा तं चिय झायन्ती सुरवरं निए हियए,कयअणसणा वसुमई कालं काऊण उववन्ना
english: Anura vasa is one in which the pleasures of love are banished, For when does one cease to experience them?

prakrit: ईसाणनामम्मि बिइज्जकप्पे चन्दज्जुणे दिव्वविमाणयम्मि,देवस्स चन्दज्जुणनामगस्स चन्दप्पहा नाम पहाणदेवी
english: God's name is Chandapaha, the moon is full of moonbeams, The goddess of heaven names her vessels after the moon.

prakrit: एसोवि परिसमप्पइ वसुमइसुरलोयपावणो नाम,सुरसुन्दरिनामाए कहाए छट्ठो परिच्छेओ
english: What's this noise about? It's the name of that lovely man Who used to decorate his room With paintings of beautiful women? "was the refrain of six paragraphs.

prakrit: अह पुव्वसङ्गएणं समयं चन्दज्जुणेण देवेण,गạ̄धाणुरायरत्ता भुञ्जइ दियलोगसोक्खाइं
english:
Oh! the time has come For the moon to rejoice With flowers; Now, dear girl, The rays of the moon Have roasted the sweetwood trees.
चन्दप्पहदेवीए सुरलोए सुरवरेण तेण समं,बोलीणो बहुकालो दिव्वसुहं अणुहवन्तीए	The goddess of the moon spoke for a long time, Equal to her in melody with the moonlight.

prakrit: अह अन्नया कयाइवि विच्छायं पिच्छिऊण नियदइयं,भयभीया सा देवी तं देवं एवमुल्लवइ
english: Oh! what a frightful goddess! She is so afraid of being chased by some strange creature That she does not even know it is a god.

prakrit: सामिय! कीस ससङ्को अरइपरद्धोव्व दीससि तुमन्ति,तह कन्त! रुइविवज्जियदेहो दीणोव किं इण्हिं?
english: Samia! Why do you look so piteously upon Sasanko, then? What do you mean, a day spent in tears?"

prakrit: सुक्कइ कीस अकम्हा कुसुमसमूहो सिरम्मि सञ्जमिओ?,वसणाणि तुज्झ सामिय! सामलवन्नाणि किं अहुणा?
english: Why so dry? Can't you see the clusters of yokels Rising in the west? Stay where you are! What makes a woman so hot?"

prakrit: थरहरइ कीस दिट्ठी कामम्मि य सịधिलआयरो इण्हिं,मोडसि य कीस अङ्गं पुणो पुणो,देव! वज्जरसु?
english: Why tremble at the very sight Of that lovely man Whose limbs are twisted Once again? God, is it thunderous?"

prakrit: अह चन्दज्जुणदेवो एवं पुट्ठो पियाए वज्जरइ,किं न याणसि सुन्दरि! जेण ममं पुच्छसि इमं तु?
english:
Ah, the moon - eyed god, And the buttocks are dripping with drink. Don't you know you are a beauty! If you ask me, Is this you?
देवस्स चवणसमए इमाणि जायन्ति सुयणु! लिङ्गाणि!,ता मज्झवि चुइसमओ आसन्नो वट्टइ इयाणिं	At the time of God's rest, these women go to sleep! And the lingam! So, too, do I need to go to my husband's bedside or to his wife's.

prakrit: एवं निसम्म वयणं देवी अइवल्लहस्स देवस्स,उपन्नगरुयसोया दुक्खं नरओवमं पत्ता
english: And without a doubt, the goddess is one of God's most beloved, like a man possessed by a demon afflicted with illness.

prakrit: अह अन्नया कयाइवि सो देवो तीइ पिच्छमाणीए,खरतरपवणसमुद्धयदीवोव्व अदंसणीभूओ
english: Oh! my God! It is a slippery slope! But the God of Love, Who dwells in deep waters, Appears invisible to all.

prakrit: दट्ठूण चुयं देवं देवी चन्दप्पहा सुदुक्खत्ता,मुच्छाविरमे करुणं विलविउमेवं समारद्धा
english: When the gods saw her they were filled with compassion. When the moon saw her happiness They were moved to tears.

prakrit: हा! नाह! पाणवल्लह! मोत्तूण ममं गओ कहिं देव!,तुमए रहिया सामिय! कं सरणमहं पवज्जामि?
english:
Yes! No! Waterman! Kill me, my God! Where have you been? Stay with me, Samia! How can I return home?
खणलवमेत्तम्पि तुमं विणा मए नेव नाह! अच्छन्तो,मोत्तूण ममं इण्हिं कत्थ गओ लोयणाणन्द!	I can't live without you, my dear! But where have you been all this time Since my husband left for Loynananda?

prakrit: तं चेव मज्झ सरणं तं नाहो जीवियं तुमं देव!,तुमए मुक्का सामिय! भण इण्हिं कत्थ वच्चामि?
english: You have saved my life! No, you are a god! But where am I going to get it?"

prakrit: हा! कत्थ गओ वल्लह! एत्थ अणाहं ममं पमोत्तूणं,को मह सरणं इण्हिं सामिय! तुमए पमुक्काए?
english:
Hey! Where have you been! You stupid bitch! Here I am waiting for you, Who cares if I'm still alive? You fool?
सो चेव देवलोगो देवसहस्सोवसोहिओ रम्मो,तुह विरहियाए इण्हिं भावइ नरओवमो मज्झ	It is the Lord God's pleasure to make love to you, and it is my desire that you should separate you from me, for I am like a man possessed by a demon.
तं चिय इमं विमाणं रम्मं मणिकणगरयणविच्छुरियं,तुमए मुक्कं भावइ घडियालयसच्छहं नाह!	Because you are so eager to see the moonlit night sky, You must be thinking of the clock!
किङ्करवग्गोपि इमो चाडुकरो विणयकरणतल्लिच्छो,परमाहम्मियसरिसो भासइ तुह नाह! विरहम्मि	Kinkaroo, you stupid cowgirl, Staring at the fence, You look like you're about to fall apart, Don't be alarmed!

prakrit: पुंनागनागचम्पयनमेरुमन्दाररेहिरं रम्मं,उज्जाणं तुह विरहे असिपत्तवणंव पडिहाइ
english: Love without fear, Love without anger, Love devoid of passion, Is an inexhaustible force.

prakrit: वरमज्जणवावीओ निम्पलजलपूरियाओ रम्माओ,भासन्ति तुज्झ विरहे वेयरणिनईए तुल्लाओ
english: Wretched women, Full of nectar, Make love; It seems as if the bracelets of separation on your body Are hanging loose.

prakrit: धन्नाओ नारीओ जाओ मयं अणुसरन्ति भत्तारं,एयम्मि देवभावे कत्तो एयारिसं मज्झ?
english: Happy women! I have a running fever. Where in the Godhead am I now?"

prakrit: एमाइ पलवमाणा सा देवी हणइ नियय हत्थेहिं,अङ्गाइं सुदुक्खत्ता कन्दन्ती करुणसद्देण
english: This is the God of Love, Who gives souls at will, Whose limbs are straight and whose limbs are smooth, Who dispenses mercy.

prakrit: मुच्छिज्जइ पुणरुत्तं नीसाहारा य पडइ भूमीए,सम्पत्तचेयणा सा पुणरवि एवं समुल्लवइ
english: To wither away or fall to the ground One must again plunder and plunder One's wealth.

prakrit: हा! नाह! किं न पेच्छसि विलवन्तिं जं न देसि उल्लावं,किं वा रुट्ठो वल्लह! किं अवरद्धं मए तुज्झ?
english:
Yes! no! Why do you not watch the wailings That do not cause you to break out, Or why, you rote lover! Am I supposed to follow you?
पणयकुवियाए सामिय! चाडुसहस्साणि मज्झ कुव्वन्तो,इण्हिं कीस अकण्डे विलवन्तिं मुञ्चसि ममं तु?	Proud wife, Samia! My husband is angry. Why are you still angry with me When he's back again?

prakrit: हा! नाह! किं न याणसि अइगुरुअणुरायमोहिया एसा,मह विरहे कह होही जेण अकण्डे तुमे मुक्का?
english:
Yes! No! Aren't you afraid That, being so demanding of your lover, I might part ways With you If, for one thing, you ever break up with him?
एवं बहुप्पगारं पिययमविरहम्मि कन्दमाणा सा,जाया उम्मूलियकमलिणिव्व विच्छायमुहकमला	And the lotus flower, Which is like a lotus in a nectar, Is very fragrant When opened with water.

prakrit: दट्ठूण गरुयसोयं गुरुदुक्खसमोहयं तयं देविं,तीए निद्धवयंसा सयम्पभा एवमुल्लवइ
english: When a woman sees a god, She is moved by her feelings, When a man sees a woman's sorrows And acts as a healer.

prakrit: जाणियजिणवयणावि हु संसारसरूवयं सुणेऊण,इयरमहिलव्व पियसहि! विलवसि किं एरिसं बहुहा?
english:
I have heard so much about you from other people's walks of life, And now I can hear it with all the ears of the world. Your wife is thirsty! Will you complain again? Is this too much for you?
पियसहि! न हु साहारो बहुणावि हु विलविएण जं अत्थि,ता किं छालियगलथणसमेण विहलेण रुन्नेण?	Thirsty! I cannot help it, I am very thin and wretched at the moment I cry out. So why cry out loud While the nail mark is still visible?

prakrit: जइ विलवसि सयहुत्तं पिट्टसि देहं करेसि गुरुसोयं,तहवि हु न एइ दइओ कालकयन्तेण जो नीओ
english: If you moan, Your limbs quiver, And your body twists, You'll do it yourself, But you won't because of this anomaly of time Which you took.

prakrit: तो एयं नाऊणं नेहं सịधिलेसु मुञ्च गुरुसोगं,उज्जम जिणिन्दधम्मे एवंविहदुक्खसमणम्मि
english: Now therefore, do not take this name from me: It is my master's gift to you: To live brightly, in the midst of adversity and the presence of suffering.

prakrit: सो तवसञ्जमरूवो देवभवे नत्थि वट्टमाणाए,सम्मत्तसुद्धिहेउं सुन्दरि! ता उज्जमं कुणसु
english: She walks in circles so that no one can see her. But beware: She is perfectly healthy And looks beautiful! Keep her eyes bright."

prakrit: गन्तूण विदेहेसुं वन्दसु तिलोक्कबन्धवजिणिन्दे,केवलिणो तह साहू सञ्जमकरणुज्जए धीरे
english:
Traveler, If you ever want to go abroad, Stop being touchy And take a rest. Only after you've spent the night elsewhere Will you be able to make it slowly.
सासयजिणभवणट्ठियजिणिन्दबिम्बाणि परमभत्तीए,कुलसेलदीवपव्वयठियाणि गन्तूण पणमेसु	Mother - in - law, Please allow me to go to my parents'house, Wherever they are staying, As long as I am safe.
एवं विसुद्धसम्मत्तसञ्जुया पाविऊण मणुयत्तं,लद्धुं जिणवरदिक्खं हयकम्मा वयसि सिद्धीए	And if you want to attain enlightenment And are able to control your emotions, You have to fight to the death To see what true wisdom is all about.
एवंविहदुक्खाइं तत्थ गया नेव पाविसि अवस्सं,जरमरणरोगसोगेहिं वज्जिया होसि आकालं	And since the separation was painful, there has never been a worse time for you to be ill with the germ.
एवं सयम्पभाए भणिया चन्दप्पहा तहिं देवी,मोत्तुण दइयसोगं समागया एत्थ लोयम्मि	And when the moon was full of rain clouds She was a goddess, And when death came She was associated with mercy In this world.
सहिया सयम्पभाए वन्दित्ता जिणवरिन्दबिम्बाइं,नन्दीसरम्मि ताहे समागया एत्थ भरहम्मि	Friend, My sister - in - law offers Me a mouthful of sweets, A heart full of love Only when one's affection is satisfied.
तत्थ य पेच्छइ नयरे रायगिहे पवरबाहिरूज्जाणे,समणगणसेवियकमं ससुरासुरमणुयपरियरियं	There she is, looking down the road at her rivals, Their husbands abroad And their wives abroad.
धम्मं वागरमाणं सुहङ्करं नाम केवलिं ताहे,गयणाओ ओयरिया सा देवी पियसहिसमेया	Only in the name of the most beautiful thing in the world, the goddess of love, Who is so affectionate, Can anyone sing the song of praise?
वन्दिय सुहङ्करं तं सुहं करन्तं तु भवियसत्ताणं,सेसम्पि समणसङ्घं उवविट्ठा उचियदेसम्मि	If you wish to please her, You can only do so in good faith; This union of equals will bring about a just judgment.
अह सो भयवं तीए सदेवमणुयासुराइपरिसाए,गम्भीरभारईए एवं भणिउं समाढत्तो	Oh! she was so afraid! She turned her face away from him, Taking him for a godly man, And saying, "I agree.

prakrit: अइदुलहो मणुयभवो सुकुलुप्पत्ती जिणिन्दधम्मो य,पत्तम्मि तम्मि उज्जमह सव्वहा मा पमाएह
english: If this is the case, My dear, If you desire to enjoy your pleasure, Do not neglect to decorate yourself with bright flowers.

prakrit: करगहियसलिलसरिसं खणे खणे झिज्जए इमं आउं,तम्हा जिणवरधम्मे मा हु पमायं कुणह तुम्हे
english: Come, I beg of you, If you wish to escape from my heart, I will arrange for you to stay where you are For the rest of my life.

english: Kusasuya, The water flowing in the nectar of anger, Is like a flame burning in the fire of passion Which has already begun to burn.

english: Because of my husband, all the sorrow is here in the world, But if you flout the rules, It's as if I am the one who dies.

english: This is the hour when death and illness come our way, when power roams the skies

english: When she dies, you will do your best to revive her, For the dharma has taught her a whole new way of seeing the world.

prakrit: परमत्थबन्धुभूए इमम्मि धम्मम्मि उज्जमं कुणह,निद्धूयसव्वपावा पावह तो मोक्खसोक्खाइं
english: The supreme friend, may my dharma glow brightly, may you find all the blessings of love, and may you attain liberation.

prakrit: नाउं कहन्तरं सा देवी चन्दप्पहा इमं भणइ,भयवं! कत्थुववन्नो दइओ चन्दज्जुणो मज्झ?

No! But after a while the goddess speaks to him of the moon - eyed man, Afraid! Where, O God of Love, Is the moon Man's mother?

english: And if you ask me, How old is she? She is very young, She is a goddess, And she is very beautiful."

english: When I saw you I was blown away; My spirit soared. But the sandalwood tree was destroyed by the fire of love."

prakrit: भणियं गुरुणा य तओ होउ अविग्धं तुहेत्थ वत्थुम्मि,अम्मापिऊहिं मुक्को अह सो पव्वाविओ गुरुणा
english: I agree, my dear, That when my brother took me in his arms You proved incompetent. But my mother - in - law has turned my back on me, And now my husband is my guru.

prakrit: अब्भसियदुविहसिक्खो सञ्जमतवविणयकरणउज्जुत्तो,विहिणागुरुपामूले अहिज्जिउं सो समाढत्तो
english: Without a trace of jealousy or anger, Like the angry wife who begs to be forgiven, He disappears in silence.

prakrit: सिग्घ महामई सो जाओ सुत्तत्थतदुमभयविहिन्नू,चुद्दसपुव्वी गुरुसाहुसम्मओ गुणगणावासो
english: With a broad smile on her face She goes from strength to strength, With fear and longing She keeps count of her virtues Until her husband returns.

prakrit: नाऊण जोगयं से सुहरिक्खे सूरिणा नियपयम्मि,अहिसित्तो सूरीवि य संलिहियतणू गओ मोक्खं
english: Now, if you want to be happy, Just set fire to the sun and let the sun find its way back home.

prakrit: समणगणसम्परिवुडो सुहम्मसूरीवि विविहदेसेसु,बोहिन्तो भवियजणं विहरइ पुरगामनगरेसु
english: Diverse countries boast of pleasant summers, But in the old town the traveler's wife made him wander.

prakrit: धणवाहणोवि कमसो वड्ढन्तो पञ्चधाइपरियरिओ,पत्तो कुमरभावं अहिज्जिओ तह कलानिवहं
english: The smoker has less work, grows five times as much, and has no more leaves than an eel.

prakrit: पत्तो य जोव्वणं सो कामिणिजणहिययचोरणसमत्थं,पिउणा य तन्निमित्तं वरिया वररुवसम्पन्ना
english: After all, youth is like stealing from a lover, Like drinking from one's lover Until the bridegroom has had his way.

prakrit: सिरिसुप्पइट्ठनयरे धूया हरिदत्तपवरइब्भस्स,विणयवईसंमूया 'णङ्गवई नाम वरकन्ना
english: Sirisuppa, On this day the gods bathe in the fragrance of turmeric flowers." "Nangavai is the name given to a bridegroom's name.

prakrit: महया विच्छड्डेणं परिणीया सोहणम्मि सा लग्गे,धणवाहणेण तत्तो आणीया निययनयरीए
english: The buffalo is crossing the river, Parineeti is sitting on her lap, And the elephant is riding on her back.

prakrit: अह सो तीए रत्तो जोव्वणवररुवसोउमल्लेसु,गाढं विसयासत्तो गयंवि कालं न याणाइ
english: Oh! the way she walks, Swollen with youth, Not knowing when the darkest hour has passed."

prakrit: अह अन्नया सुधम्मो विहरन्तो मुणिवरो तहिं पत्तो,विजयवईनयरीए वासारत्तस्स पारम्भे
english: Ah! the path is smooth, The path is slippery, Like a river in spate When swept by the triumphant stream.

prakrit: साहूहिं तत्थ वसही विमग्गिया ताहि सत्थवाहेण,धणभूइणा विदिन्ना सुविसुद्धा जाणसालासु
english: The landowner's son - in - law lives in such a way that, with his faithful wife and children at hand, he acquires a good reputation.

prakrit: नियपरियणेण सहिओ सत्थाहो एइ गुरुसमीवम्मि,सामाइयाइजुत्तो संविग्गो सुणइ जिणघम्मं
english: Friend, be patient: This is the teacher's third hour, And when he sits down to explain it to you, He listens intently.

prakrit: धणवाहणो उ दइयासुरयसुहासत्तमाणसो धणियं,पिउणा भणिओवि दढं न ए इ गुरुवन्दओ कहवि
english: The master said," "You have to drink water, To enjoy the pleasure Of being treated with compassion - There is no medicine for it."

prakrit: अहतं विसयासत्तं गुरुरागं धम्मकरणनिरवेक्खं,परिचत्तसेसकज्जं दट्ठुं लहुभायरं गुरुणो
english: Without a trace of pride I shall never forget how my teacher treated me: He looked at me with such longing That I could never forget him.

prakrit: जाया एसा चिन्ता भाया मे रागमोहिओ वरओ,जिणवयणबाहिरमई इन्दियविसएसु आसत्तो
english: If I think of it this way, angry young man, I hope to live some other way In India also.

prakrit: दुल्लहमवि मणुयत्तं पावित्ता धम्मविरहिओ एसो,गच्छिस्सइ नरयम्मि घोरासु य तिरियजोणीसुं
english:
Here comes the God of Love, Friend of God, Who is devoid of purity and purity: There goes the man whose hair falls to the ground In a trance.
केणावि उवाएणं बोहेमि रागमोहियं एयं,एवं विचिन्तिऊणं गुरुणा सद्दाविओ भाया	Somebody said, "I'm very angry, and the teacher thought it was a joke."

prakrit: महया उवरोहेणं समागओ वन्दिऊण तो सूरिं,उवविट्ठो से पुरओ अह सूरि भणिउमाढत्तो
english: When the sun rises Above me I gather affection, When the wind blows it is only the sun.

prakrit: पोग्गलपरियट्टेहिं बहूहिं सम्पाविऊण मणुयत्तं,हारेसु मा मुहाए विसयामिसमोहिओ भद्द!
english: By confining yourself to your lover's house, you will not hurt the feelings of others. So do not trouble yourself by turning your back on him!

prakrit: विसएसु दढं सत्ता सत्ता बन्धन्ति असुहकम्माइं,तव्वसओ संसारे भमन्ति अहमासु जोणीसु
english: Such wicked men seize power, seize it, cause hurt, and then roam the world as though they had no more.

prakrit: वहबन्धमारणाई नाणाविहवेयणाओ नरएसु,पाविन्ति विसयगिद्धा दूसहाओ दीहरं कालं
english: She is not afraid of being tied up, Of being robbed of her coin, But of a long life, Two hundred and fifty years.

prakrit: अच्छउ ता परलोए इहेव पाविन्ति गुरुयदुक्खाइं,विसयपसत्ता दुद्दन्तइन्दिया देहिणो बहवे
english: But really, these are the sorrows of a miser's past, For after a long illness The rivers of milk flow towards India."

prakrit: मोत्तूण निययजूहं करेणुसुहसुरयफासपडिबद्धो,बद्धो वारीबन्धे फासेण गओ गओ निहणं
english: The farmer has committed suicide, The farmer is committing suicide, And the farmer has gone into hiding Because he was so caught up in the trap.

prakrit: रसणिन्दियम्मि लुद्धो विद्धो गलएण मच्छओ निहओ,धाणिन्दियम्मि सत्तो पत्तो उरगोवि मरणदुहं
english: A snake bites a lotus, A mosquito pierces a rose, And seven emeralds stick to the water of love, Which is the poison of death.

prakrit: उज्जोइयसयलदिसं दीवसिहं पेच्छिउं पयङ्गोवि,तग्गहणरओ मरणं पत्तो नणु चक्खुदोसेण
english: The fire that burns bright, The lamp that burns red, Looks like a scarecrow's tail - One that bristles at the slightest sign of death.

prakrit: गोरीसद्दासत्तो निच्चलतड्डवियकन्नजुयलिल्लो,सवणिन्दियदोसेणं मिओ मओ वाहबाणेण
english: The dog was immovably wounded by the sharp arrows Of the God of Love, And the elephant was wounded by them.

prakrit: एक्किक्किन्दियवसगा एए सव्वेवि पाविया निहणं,पञ्चिदियवसगाणं नराण पुण का गई होज्जा?
english: With the one and only God, all sinners have passed away, but with the song of the five days, has sin returned?"

prakrit: ता पञ्चिदियवसगो विसयसुहं सेविऊण मा भद्द!,धम्मोवज्जणरहिओ वच्चसु घोरम्मि नरयम्मि
english: So do not be alarmed when five days are passing and you enjoy your pleasure! There is something very wrong with you, poor girl, Being led astray by false gods."

prakrit: किज्जउ धम्मम्मि मई विसयसुहं उज्झिऊण ता इण्हिं,सहलीकरेसु सुन्दर! अइदुलहं मणुयजम्मन्ति
english:
Why, dhammammy, If you want to awaken the ecstasy of longing, You'd better take me with you! I swear by people who are born with eyes like that.
एयं गुरुणो वयणं निसम्म धणवाहणो इमं भणइ,इच्छामि तुम्हवयणं किं पुण निसुणेह मह भणियं	It is the master's fault I speak of him as a dishonest jeweler; I want you to understand why I always speak of you.
अइनेहपरा वरई खणमवि विरहं न सक्कए सọ̄धुं,दइया 'णङ्गवई मह तेण न सक्केमि तं मोत्तुं	A miser's wife cannot separate herself from her lover, For I can't kill her if she gives birth to him.

prakrit: तुब्भम्पि वन्दणत्थं आगमणं तेण होइ न मज्झ,मह विरहे सा वरई इण्हिम्पि हु अच्छए किच्छं
english: It is not for me to speak of your return, for apart from me the bridegroom is bound to come. How can I help it?

prakrit: तत्तो गुरुणा भणियं चञ्चलचित्ताणं महिलिआण कए,को व सकन्नो पुरिसो हारिज्जा अप्पयं भद!
english: Well, master, tell me, Who can beat a man's head with such agility When it comes to women?

prakrit: पवणुद्धुयधयचञ्चलचित्तासुं महिलिआसु आसत्तो,जो धम्मम्मि पमायइ,सो काउरिसो न सप्पपुरिसो
english: If there is a woman with a firm faith and a steady mind, Who follows the dharma, She is not cowardly, Nor is she pure.

prakrit: अविय अन्तोविसभरियाओ मणहररुवाओ बज्झवित्तीए,गुञ्जाफलसरिसाओ हॊन्ति सभावेण महिलाओ
english: Lovely women, Full of beauty and fragrance, Buzzing with thunder and lightning, Proud ladies."

prakrit: सच्चदयसोयरहिया अकज्जनिरयाओ साहसधणाओ,भयजणणीओ,तासुं को व सकन्नो रइं कुज्जा?
english: You honesthearted ones, You tireless workers, You brave women, You fearful ones, Who then can be so cruel?

prakrit: रत्ताओ हरन्ति धणं पाणेवि हरन्ति तह विरत्ताओ,रागेवि विरागेवि य भयङ्करा दुट्ठजुवईओ
english: The nights are long, The riches are abundant, The days are fleeting, The weeks are angry, and the nights are frightful.

prakrit: अन्नं चिन्तेन्ति मणे नियन्ति अन्नं धडेन्ति अन्नेण,चलचित्ताणं ताणं को नाम हविज्ज वल्लहओ?
english: They think of food, They decide what should be eaten, They study food, And who needs a name If he has a good mind?

prakrit: मारेन्ति पइ जारस्स कारणे तम्पि हन्दि! अन्नट्ठा,वीसासन्ति य अन्नं सब्भावं नेय पयडेन्ति
english:
My brother - in - law has committed suicide because his wife is adulterous! In the end, they will all perish as a result of their greed.
किं बहुणा भणिएणं जाओ य हणन्ति निययपुत्तम्पि,को नाम पिओ तासिं हविज्ज चवलाण महिलाण?	Why so many people are going to say,'He killed my youngest son, "and'I killed his first wife "?

prakrit: ता भद्द! एरिसाणं तडिच्छडाडोवचवलहिययाणं,महिलाण कए को इह हविज्ज सịधिलायरो धम्मे?
english: That's nasty! It's as if a flock of parrots has been introduced to the river For the first time in a month. "Who is going to decorate this sacred place for women?

prakrit: इय गुरुभणियं सोउं विहसिय धणवाहणेण संलत्तं,अन्नाओ जुवईओ एवंविहदुट्ठचरियाओ
english: This is Guru Bhaniam's daughter - in - law attached to her husband's carriage, and his brothers are juveniles and widowers.

prakrit: मह महिला पुण सरला पइव्वया सच्चसीलदयजुत्ता,अणुरत्ता सुविणीया थिरनेहा गुरुजणे भत्ता
english: My dear, A decent woman is one who gives her all, Who is truthful, Who listens to her husband's advice, And who is generous with her gifts?

prakrit: सरिसा सा कह होज्जा असुद्धचरियाण अन्नमहिलाण?,लोहतुरङ्गाईणं दीसइ गुरु अन्तरं लोए
english: Sirisa, how come you are such a friendly person?," "The iron bracelet shows the inner world of the master."

prakrit: तत्तो गुरुणा भणियं मणोहरा तुज्झ जइवि सा महिला,तहवि हु उवभुज्जन्ता सरणी सा नरयनयरस्स
english: Master, tell me, If you like being a woman, You'd better take me in your arms When I'm with you On the river bank.

prakrit: जह किम्पागफलाइं भुत्ताइं दुहावहाइं इह हॊन्ति,तह इत्थीसुरयसुहं मणहरमवि दोग्गइं नेइ
english: As the nectar of an early summer sun does not rob a pleasant man of his pleasant pastime, As the kimpa fruit roasts twice in the afternoon.

prakrit: जह विसमीसं सरसम्पि भोयणं जीवियं हरइ भुत्तं,तह सुन्दरावि रमणी रमिया नणु दोग्गइं देइ
english: As soon as one has spent one's life in penury, That lovely young girl gives birth to two handsome sons.

prakrit: ता उज्झसु अणुरायं कुगइनिमित्ताए निययदइयाए,पञ्चमहव्वयजुत्तो होसुं तुमं चरणनिरउत्ति
english: Then, please, arrange for Kugai Puraskaram in the morning, for the five great vows will bring you to your feet."

prakrit: एवं दिवसे दिवसे संवेगकरेहिं महुरवयणेहिं,बोहिज्जन्तो मणयं जाओ अह पयणुरागो सो
english: And every day I get more and more emotional. But please, my traveler, be careful not to fall into the trap of overspending yourself.

prakrit: अन्नदिणे एगन्ते गुरुपुरओ अञ्जलिं करेऊण,धणवाहणो स एवं वज्जरई परमसंविग्गो
english: Now when the elders come together, They perform the rites of adoration; The warrior and his wife enter into supreme communion.

prakrit: तुम्हाणममयभूए वयणे निसुएवि मज्झ हिययाओ,किं नो सक्कइ रागो विसंव दुट्ठस्स सप्पस्स?
english: O my heart, How is it that you are so angry With me, And I am so helpless When you are away?

prakrit: भयवं! ताव न तुट्टइ दइयाए उवरि सव्वहा रागो,नवरं करेमि एक्कं जइ जुत्तं तुम्ह पडिहाइ
english:
Be afraid! Don't let that break you. Everyone is angry with you. I'll do it again If only you could fall in love With me.
सुरयसुहनिप्पिवासो दिक्खं गिण्हामि तुम्ह पामूले,दइयाए समं अहयं दंसणमित्तेण सन्तुट्ठो	I can count on you, my dear, To look at you in the sun, To be satisfied with my presence at your feet.
एवं ववत्थियम्मि जइ जोग्गं देह मज्झ तो दिक्खं,तीए अदंसणेणं सक्केमि न जीवियं धरिउं	And if I see your body as it is now, I cannot help but live to see it.
तव्वयणं सोऊण य सुधम्मसूरि विचिन्तए एवं,पेच्छह अइदुरन्तो रागो कह विलसए लोए?	When you think back on your dreams and dreamt them over, Do you see how people become angry at each other And lose their cool?
एवम्पि ता दिज्जउ पव्वज्जा ताहि गहियसुत्तत्थो,सयमेव विवेगजुओ उज्झिस्सइ रागसम्बन्धं	Only then will you be able to give expression To what is deeply rooted in your soul, Always stirring up the most discerning of emotions.
एवं विचिन्तिऊणं अणङ्गवइयाए सञ्जुओ ताहे,धणवाहणो सभाया गुरुणा पव्वाविओ विहिणा	And when the hunter's wife saunters in, The hunter is deprived of his treasure, And the huntsman his master.
चन्दजसानामाए मयहरियाए समप्पिया सावि,साहुणिगणमज्झगया सिक्खइ वरसाहुणीकिरियं	Aunt, When the moon is full of moonlight She forgets how to sleep. When the clouds gather She learns how to make rain
एवं च ताण दोण्हवि परोप्परं जाव तुट्टइ न रागो,बहुणावि हु कालेणं सुत्तत्थ विसारयाणम्पि	And yet, when the twain are face to face One does not get angry, For sometimes I get angry And go on making love.

prakrit: ताव य गुरुणा भणियं एगन्ते भारईए महुराए,एयं न जुत्तमहुणा उत्तमसत्ताण तुम्हाण
english: When your master tells you that he intends to marry you, That does not make you a better man.

prakrit: अविरइजुवइजणेवि हु सवियारपलोयणम्मि साहुस्स,पायच्छित्तं गरुयं भणियं सुत्ते जिणिन्दस्स
english: I will never forget how my parents made me feel When I was a child, When I tried to escape, And when I fell asleep beside my parents.

prakrit: जं पुण साहुणि विसए सवियारपलोयणं तु साहुस्स,तं भद्द! गुरुअणत्थस्स कारण वन्नियं समए
english: You have to endure whatever wrongs you commit, As long as you practice good manners! It is because of your parents That you have committed a crime."

prakrit: तेणं उवायपुव्वं घडिया सा तुज्झ कणगमालाओ,इण्हिं सकम्म्वसओ जाओ तुह तीइ सह विरहो
english: It was like a miracle, You're the only one who knows how to kiss her, And I can part with you forever.

prakrit: भो चित्तवेग! बहुणा किंवा भणिएण एत्थ अन्नेण?,जं चेव आसि पुट्ठं तं चिय तुह ताव साहेमि
english:
Be reasonable! Too much! Or should I say,'Here come the others '? I agree with you, Son, inasmuch as all the rest of you have done so.
कणगरहो सो साहू अइप्पिओ आसि तुज्झ अन्नभवे,तत्तो य देवलोए विहुप्पहो नाम जो देवो	Be reasonable! The farmer will come to you With plenty of food, For there is a God hidden among the trees, Called the God of Love.

prakrit: सो य अहं तुह वल्लहमित्तो अज्जवि तत्थ वसामि दिवम्मि,कारणमित्थमिमं तु पडुच्च मे अइसङ्गयओ सि तुमन्ति
english: I was in love with you then, and I'm staying here today, because you introduced me to your stepson."

prakrit: एसो एत्थ समप्पइ चिरपरिचियवन्नणॊत्ति नामेण,सुरसुन्दरिकहाए अट्ठमओ वरपरिच्छेओ
english: Come, let's stop here for a while. Name me a familiar woman. Let the eighth bridegroom come, Handsome woman."

prakrit: अह भणइ चित्तवेगो सुरवर! मह कहसु केण कज्जेण,तइया मणिं समप्पिय कत्थ गओ आसि तुरियगई?
english:
My dear, tell me, What need you of my asking me? Where did you finish the money And when did you retire?
तो भणइ सुरो सुन्दर! निसुणसु एयम्पि वज्जरिज्जन्तं,अज्ज अहं आणत्तो ससिप्पहेणं तु देवेण	So tell me, Your voice is beautiful! Stop bothering me, Mr. Vajjarijant. I have brought you today in the guise of your father - in - law's supplication.
गच्छ विहुप्पह! खिप्पं जम्बूद्वीवम्मि भरहखेत्तम्मि,नयरे कुसग्गनामे धणवाहणमुणिवरसमीवे	Go - between! It's a long way from now. The river Jambudweepami is in full bloom. There goes the God of Love, Who in my heart is a bow - bearer of jewels!

prakrit: सो पुव्ववेरिएणं दिट्ठो झाणम्मि सण्ठिओ तत्थ,तं दट्ठु कुविओ सो काही अइगरुयउवसग्गं
english: He looked at the flower seller's wife And then, looking at her, He saw something awry on the girl's back."

prakrit: ता तस्स रक्खणट्ठा सिग्धं वच्चाहि तम्मि नयरम्मि,अहमवि इन्दाणत्तिं समाणिउं आगमिस्सामि
english: Then I will come to you safe and sound, As if I had never seen you before.

prakrit: तत्तो तहत्ति भणिउं वेगेण समागओ अहं इहइं,तावय दइयासहिओ पलायमाणो तुमं दिटिठो
english: Then he said," "I am coming quickly, but your eyes are on me as I flee from you."

prakrit: ओहिनाणेण मए नायं जह एस सो हि विज्जुपहो,मह मित्तो नहवाहणभयाउरो वच्चए तुरियं
english: He is not afraid of me because I am not his follower; rather, he is afraid of my friend and his wife.

prakrit: नहवाहणोवि एसो पटिठविलग्गो इमस्स एइत्ति,ताहे करेमि किञ्चिवि उवगारं पुव्वमित्तस्स
english: Behold the landowner's son; behold, he is coming up from the river; I will do whatever I can to make him happy.

prakrit: एवं विचिन्तिऊणं तुम्ह समीवम्मि आगओ अहयं,तइया य मणी दिव्वो समप्पिओ जीवरक्खट्ठा
english: And just think of you. Come on, you dimwit: This is the only way to extinguish the flames of a fire.

prakrit: तत्तो य गओ तुरियं घणवाहणमुणिवरस्स पासम्मि,दिट्ठो य मए देवो उवसग्गं तस्स कुणमाणो
english: There you go, Turiam, Standing beside the colossal shipwreck. Look, I suppose God wants you in such a position."

prakrit: भणियं च मए रे! रे! तियसाहम! कत्थ वच्चसे इण्हिं,देविदवन्दियाणं मुणीण एवं करेमाणो?
english:
Brother, I have to go! Hey! What are you doing here again, Fooling the gods and goddesses?
उप्पायन्तो पीडं मुणीण समसत्तुमित्तवग्गाणं,पाविट्ठ! कत्थ वच्चसि दिट्ठीमग्गम्मि मह पडिओ?	My poor girl, When all this trouble has stopped, You fool! Where did you get that look In my eye That I fell over?

prakrit: एवं च मए भणिए भवणवई सो सुरो ससम्भन्तो,नट्ठो सहसा ताव य सुक्कज्झाणे पविट्ठस्स
english: And I say," "He who recites the Bhavanavai swears by it, not by chance, but by the auspiciousness of its verses."

prakrit: मुणिणो मोहावगमा उप्पन्नं केवलं वरं नाणं,केवलिमहिमा विहिया तओ मए परमविणएणं
english: A sage's penance is merely a token of blessing, But my loving - kind heart can only do so much for my supreme bliss.

prakrit: सोउं दुन्दुहिसद्दं देवा मणुया य आगया बहवे,कहिओ तेसिं धम्मो केवलिणा मोक्खसुहहेऊ
english: If you believe that God is angry and angry with you, then burn with fire and say," "Only in your faith can you enjoy liberation."

prakrit: पत्थावं लहिऊणं पुट्ठो सो केवली मए एवं,भयवं! किं अवरद्धं इमस्स देवस्स तुम्हेहिं
english: Put down the stone, for it is mine alone, and I am afraid! What use is it to you, my God?"

prakrit: जेणेसो पावमई जीवियववरोवणम्मि उज्जुत्तो?,तो भणइ मुणी निसुणसु जह वेरं आसि अन्न भवे
english: Does the sage disapprove, Since he is so forthright about living a sinful life? "She replies," "No, of course he does not. There must be food elsewhere.

prakrit: धायइसण्डविदेहे चम्पानामेण आसि वरनयरी,तीए पउमो राया जुवराया समरकेउत्ति
english: In the rainy season The rice seller's daughter - in - law comes out with a flourish, And her husband is at war with the jeweler

prakrit: जिणवयणभावियप्पा सहोयरा दोवि नेहसञ्जुत्ता,पालेन्ति देसविरइं रज्जधुरं तह य नीईए
english: Both jealousy and jealousy combine to take the life of a man. Yet the king's enemies have turned his back on him

prakrit: अत्थाणमुवगयाणं नाहियवाई समागओ कविलो,वज्जरइ नत्थि जीवो न य सव्वन्नू न नेव्वाणं
english: Poets do not gather together unless they are led by the Spirit of God; the wise do not live at all; neither do the learned.

prakrit: जिणमयसत्थत्थवियाणएण जुवराइणा जिओ वाए,दिट्ठन्तहेउकारणनाणाविहजुत्तिनिवहेण
english: For as the wind blows, So the jeweler lives, Because he sees the cause of his wife's death."

prakrit: जुवरन्नो पडिवयणं जाहे न चएइ किम्पि सो दाउं,ताहे मन्तिमहत्तमसामन्ताईहिं उवहसिओ
english: Young girls, If you don't want to go out with your husband, Sit at home with your wife and children.

prakrit: जाओ य विलक्खो सो दढं पउट्ठो य समरकेउस्स,कह णु महायणमज्झे एएणं धरिसिओ अहयं?
english: Go, or else it will be difficult for you; it may be the foot of a tree or the feet of a warrior. "How can you keep this up in the middle of a great festival?

prakrit: एवं विचिन्तयन्तो अइगुरुरोसेण धमधमन्तो सो,अत्थाणमण्डवाओ नीहरिओ चिन्तए एवं
english: And when he thinks of his enemies, He trembles with anger; At the same time he ponders over his enemies.

prakrit: न य केणइ पुव्वमहं पराइओ वाइणा इहं लोए,पावेण इमेण पुणो सभाए मज्झम्मि कह विजिओ?
english: No one can rob me of my virginity But these few men. But how can I help myself to this assembly of poets?

prakrit: ता रयणीए भवणे इमस्स गन्तूण गहियकरवालो,छिन्दामि उत्तिमङ्गं जेण मणं निव्वुइं लहइ
english:
You silly girl, I've so often described how difficult it is to get away, That I find it difficult to keep my senses.
रोद्दज्झाणोवगओ एवं सो चिन्तिऊण रयणीए,गहियाउहो पविट्ठो वासहरे समरकेउस्स	The moon was bright with rain and the night was long, For behold, a summer's morning appeared in a sacred grove.
वच्चोहरभितीए पच्छन्नो अच्छए पलीणो सो,काऊण गोसकिच्चं समागओ तत्थ जुवराया	It's past three o'clock in the afternoon, But once you've had your way it's time to mix things up.
दीवयवग्गकरेहिं नरेहिं उज्झोइएण मग्गेणं,वच्चोहरगमणिच्छा अह जाया रायउत्तस्य	I beg you, my dear, To kindle the fire in my heart Which, dear girl, Did not burn so long As it did not burn.

prakrit: पुरिसेहिं तत्थ दिट्ठो वच्चोहरसण्ठिओ स दुट्ठमई,आयड्ढन्तो खग्गं गहिओ बद्धो य सहसत्ति
english: The eyes of a man are ever fixed on his wife's breasts, The ears of a woman's husband are ever closed, And the hair of her husband is tightly fastened.

prakrit: जुवरन्ना नाओ सो नाहियवाई स एस कविलॊत्ति,नूणं वायम्मि जिओ मज्झ वहट्ठा इह पविट्ठो
english: Zuvernna nao so nahiyawaii, sis kavilotthi, nuññā vayammī jiyo mājjaṃ, This is the holy one."

prakrit: दठ्ठूण दीणवयणं वेवन्तसरीरयं तयं कविलं,परिचत्तजीवियासं जाया करुणा कुमारस्स
english: A poet is one who sees the visible, the invisible, and who conceals his true nature. But as for the soul, it is the son of compassion.

prakrit: भणियं कुमरेण तओ जीवन्तो ताव इण्हि मुक्को सि,मोत्तूण मज्झ देसं ठाएयव्वं तुमे पाव!
english: My son, you are so full of life, And yet you keep on pushing me, So that I may sacrifice my life In vain!

prakrit: इय भणिओ सो नट्ठो गन्तूणं ताहि दूरदेसम्मि,भिल्लजणाइन्नाए अवट्ठिओभिल्लपल्लीए
english: He said," "Don't stop here; you're going to a distant country. In this damned village the villagers have already left."

prakrit: अह अन्नया य पउमो पुत्तं अहिसिञ्चिऊण रज्जम्मि,जुवराइणा समेओ पव्वइओ गुरुसमीवम्मि
english: My son, this messenger is so busy fixing things up, That he can't even walk when he wants to.

prakrit: दोन्निवि गुरुणा सहिया विहरन्ता बहुविहेसु देसेसु,सत्थेण समं चलिया रयणपुरं नाम वरनयरं
english: The two masters walked side by side, Visiting many different countries. At the same time Ryanpuram was named after Varnayar."

prakrit: सत्थाओ कहवि भट्ठा दोन्निवि अडवीए मोहिया मुणिणो,सम्पत्ता पल्लीए पाणयअट्ठा पविट्ठा ते
english:
Saints, tell me that between two kilns a man is addicted to wine, And between two villages he has acquired wealth By purifying himself with water.
दिट्ठा य परियडन्ता कविलेणं कहवि पच्चभिन्नाया,कुद्धो य दढं एसो दट्ठूण मुणिं समरकेउं	A poet's vision, Whether it be by sight or by sight, Is such a difference of opinion; But as the eyes see, So are the ears.
चिन्तेइ ताहे कविलो इमेण वाएवि निज्जिओ अहयं,निव्विसओ आणत्तो तइया य इमेण पावेण	I suppose you have heard of him before, he said, "and now you think you can get him.

prakrit: ता कवडेणं केणवि वइरस्सन्तं करेमि इण्हिम्पि,इय चिन्तिऊण वन्दइ ते मुणिणो परमविणएण
english:
Well, I suppose you could do with something else; think of this: She is swooning over in ecstasy At the mere mention of her husband.
नीया य निजे गेहे विसमीसं भत्तपाणयं दिन्नं,भणिया य विणयपुव्वं भयवं! एत्थेव भुञ्जेह	No, I promise, I'll make you drink wine myself, but I fear I'm going to spit it out!

prakrit: अद्धाणगमणखिन्ना निव्वियणे एत्थ एगदेसम्मि,भुञ्जिय वीसमिउं तो पभायकाले वएज्जाह
english: An egg here on the river bank, One that has not wilted, And one that has withered By the time it is ripe.

prakrit: एवं भणिया तेणं सुहभावा वीसमित्तु खणमेगं,सज्झायं काऊणं पारद्धा भोयणं काऊं
english: And tell me, my lovely wife, How miserable it is to be angry With someone who is so forthright.

prakrit: संनिहियदेवयाए मुणिअणुकम्पाए तयं विसं हरियं,भोत्तूण तओ दोन्निवि सज्झायं काउमारद्धा
english: When the God of Love has anointed the lotus with nectar, The flowers are green. When both are fragrant They cause delight to the cowherd

prakrit: चिन्तेइ तओ कविलो हन्त विसेणं न किं मया एए,नूणं मन्तबलेणं अवहरिया होज्ज विससत्ती
english: Thinking that you are a poet, I suppose you are not. Or perhaps I am just talking nonsense?

prakrit: ता रयणीइ अवस्सं मारेयव्वो मए इमो मुण्डो,जीवन्तम्मि इमम्मि नत्थि ममं जेण सन्तोसो
english:
So Rayani's remains will be killed if I bow my head. You can live your life Your mother won't be so content.
पत्ताए रयणीए सज्झायं कट्टु साहुणो सुत्ता,कविलोवि अद्धरत्ते समागओ साहुवहणट्ठा	The farmer ties up his wife's skirt, Puts it on tightly, And puts it on gently until she falls asleep.

prakrit: आयड̣धिऊणं खग्गं जाव पहारं करेइ साहुस्स,रुट्ठाए देवयाए पहओ सो तेण खग्गेण
english: It is the God of Love who keeps watch on your behalf While you stand guard over your enemies.

prakrit: रोद्दज्झाणोवगओ मरिऊण गओ बिइज्जपुढवीए,मुणिणोवि निरइयारं सामन्नं काउं बहुकालं
english: By the time the sun is out The farmer will have to face death First on account of his business, Then after a long time He will settle down and settle down.

prakrit: कालं काउं विहिणा दोन्निवि सोहम्मनामकप्पम्मि,उप्पन्ना सुहप्पुन्ना अच्छरगणसङ्कुलविमाणे
english: Time is of the essence, Both the wife and the husband are welcome, But happiness lies in the abundance of one's possessions.

prakrit: तत्तो य पउमजीवो सागरमेगं तु आउयं तत्थ,अणुहविऊणिह दीवे एरवए विजयनयरीए
english: There you are, Living Ocean of Love, And there you will rise again, Like a lamp illuminated by the rays of the sun In victory.

prakrit: धणभूइनामगस्स ओ जाओ तणओ सुधम्मनामॊत्ति,काऊण य सामन्नं उप्पन्नो बीयकप्पम्मि
english: Aunt, There is something very strange about your husband's face That you know isn't real. Anyway, I suppose you have seen him before."

prakrit: चन्दज्जुणे विमाणे ससिप्पहो नाम सो सुरो जाओ,दो चेव सागराइं सम्पुन्नं आउयं तस्स
english: He's had enough of the moonlight," "Cursed be the name of the pilot of the plane." "Two seas, I suppose, will meet there.

prakrit: भद्द! विहुप्पह! सम्पइ विमाणसामी उ सो सुरो तुम्ह,जस्साएसेण तुमं समागओ मह समीवम्मि
english: You fool! Hanging over your wife! She is completely at ease with you, That's the way you conduct yourself, This is how you treat me."

prakrit: सो समरकेउजीवो सागरमेगं तु अट्ठपलिएहिं,अब्भहियं अणुभविउं देवभवे अह चुओ तत्तो
english: Behold, summer is coming, And the clouds of the sea are closing in on you; Now, dear God, I suppose you have found a haven for the gods.

prakrit: एत्थेव भरहखेत्ते कुसग्गनयरम्मि भद्दकित्तिस्स,रन्नो पियमहिलाए सुबन्धुदत्ताए कुच्छीए
english: Here in this field of plenty The mischievous girl next door Is crying because the good wife has kicked the butt of her suitcase."

prakrit: उप्पन्नो सो देवो जाओ य कमेण दारओ तत्तो,घणवाहणॊत्ति नामं विहियं से उचियसमयम्मि
english: But please, God, if someone knocks at the door, Don't pull the name of the traveler out of my mind While I'm there.

prakrit: वड्ढन्तो य कमेणं पत्तो अह जोव्वणं जणाणन्दं,अहिसिञ्चिय तं रज्जे जाओ समणो पिया तस्स
english: Youth passes never to return, Love's arrows never taste right, But when they touch you they calm you down.

english: Thou hast grasped the strings of many a weapon: thou, son of man, art able to bend them with the force of thy bow.

ताव य धणदेवेणं भणियं नरनाह! देसु अवहाणं,सुविणपरमत्थजाणणहेउं निसुणेसु वुत्तुन्तं	Thou art a cruel god! Destroy this land! For, knowing the ultimate truth, You have sown it,
तओ अह अडवीए दिट्ठो भिल्लवई,तेण जह य सप्पेहिं,बद्धो उ चित्तवेगो विमोइओ मणिपभावाओ	So the blind man's eyes are closed, So the snakes are quiet, Constant pretence of mind and free will.
जह तेण निययचरिए सिट्ठे देवस्स आगमो आसि,देवेण केवली अह दिट्ठो य कुसग्गनयरम्मि	As long as God's presence is within you, God can only look at you If you look at someone else's face.
जह भाविभवं पुट्ठो केवलिणा जह य तस्स आइट्ठं,सिरिअमरकेउरन्नो होहिसि पुत्तो तुमं भद्द!	As soon as you arrive home, poor girl, you're a disgrace, my son, Because you missed the trip to Syria!
जणणीइ समं तत्थ य अवहरिओ पुव्ववेरियसुरेण,ता चित्तवेग! खयराहिवस्स गेहम्मि वड̣धिहिसि	At the same time as mother - in - law, When the flowers are completely white, It's the disposition of the mind! For behold, thou art as wide as the sky.

prakrit: एमाइ पुव्वउत्तं सवित्थरं साहियं नरवइस्स,धणदेवेणं जाव य सम्पत्तो हत्थिणपुरम्मि
english:
My dear, Only men can steal my wealth, For my husband is a wealthy man And my wealth is in the hands of wealthy men.
ता देव! देविउदरे विहुप्पहो सो सुरो समुप्पन्नो,होही,जओ न केवलिवयणं इह अन्नहा होइ	So God! The God of Love has sprung up again, and now the sun is shining again. But only when the wind does not blow It is like food.

prakrit: पुव्वविरुद्धसुरेणं हरिओ खयरस्स वड̣धिओ गेहे,साहियबहुविहविज्जो मिलिही सो निययजणणीए
english:
Love's arrows pierce through the thickets of nectar, Like bees piercing a flower's blossom, But finding them beside one another, She is doomed to perish.
इच्छियकन्नादाणं मालाए पूयणम्पि मन्ना सि,एसो नरिदं! सुविणयपरमत्थो फुरइ मह हियए	If you want to dance, Put on a garland of flowers And eat the manna. This is Narida! Teach me more than just poetry.

prakrit: एयं धणदेवस्स ओ वयणं सोऊण सुविणयन्नूहिं,भणियं अहो! अउव्वं एयस्स उ बुद्धिकोसल्लं
english: It is the god of wealth, and when he spoke it was to preach the gospel:" "Ah! now is the season of wisdom!"

prakrit: सययं तल्लिच्छेहिवि बहुसत्थवियक्खणेहिं अम्हेहिं,तव्विहबुद्धिविउत्तेहिं सक्कियं नो विणिच्छेउं
english: I have looked at you with longing, But I do not see your genius.

prakrit: सुसिलिट्ठो नणु अत्थो निरूविओ राय! वणियउत्तेण,सव्वेसिं अम्हाणवि सुसंमओ चेव एसॊत्ति
english: Calm down, little girl! Stop your anger, Roy! This is the essence of our harmony for all time."

prakrit: इय भणिए ते रन्ना तम्बोलपयाणपुव्वयं सव्वे,पट्ठविया तह सव्वे सामन्तमहन्तमाईया
english: It is said," "They ran, they paraded, all the pilgrims, and all the feudal lords."

english: There I ran, My brother - in - law at my feet, And the God of Love! How easy it was for me to do this, As if I were a goddess And now I have to endure adversity.

prakrit: किं एत्थ अत्थि कोवि हु पडिघायविही सुदुट्ठसुविणस्स,भणियं धणदेवेणं न अन्नहा केवलिगिरा ओ
english: Why are you sitting here Thinking how well I've got on my feet, My dear, You clever man? For he has no more food to eat Than a god of plenty.

prakrit: तहवि हु एस उवाओ कीरइ मा होज्ज तेण पडिघाओ,मञ्चयपडियाण पुणो तहट्ठिया चेव भूमित्ति
english: Then why are you yawning so loudly? Don't be alarmed: There she is, kneeling on the stage And pouting her heart out.

prakrit: पल्लीवइणा तइया दिव्वमणी जो समप्पिओ मज्झ,सो एस अङ्गुलीयगनिवेसिओ चिट्ठउ करम्मि
english: The village headman is such a lampshade That he suppresses me only with his fingers When I write letters to him.

prakrit: एसो अचिन्तसत्ती अणेयठाणेसु दिट्ठ माहप्पो,ता एयं देवीए करट्ठियं देव! कारेह
english: This is the month of spring, When the God of Love will appear in the night sky, And God will do it!

prakrit: पुव्वविरुद्धोवि सुरो हरणे देवीइ होज्ज असमत्थो,एयस्स पभावाओ,अह कहवि करिज्ज अवहरणं
english: Because you can't make love Without first making love With someone else You'd better stop being angry With.

prakrit: तहवि हु अवगारम्मी सक्किस्सइ नेव वट्टिउं वइरी,नाउं इमं नरेसर! मा सोगं किञ्चिवि करेह
english: However much I may sulk, I will never regret it. No, my lord! So do not grieve."

prakrit: सुविणपडिघायणत्थं कारेसु जिणालएसु महिमाओ,पुएसु समणसङ्घं तदुचियवत्थासणाईहिं
english: Glory to you, gentlemen, If you do what is right in prayer You will triumph.

prakrit: दावेसु अभयदाणं विविहाभिग्गहतवेसु उज्जमसु,एवं कयम्मि नरवर! सव्वम्पि हु सुन्दरं होही
english: Brighter the days, More diverse the nights, And uglier the nights! All are fair! "is how she describes her husband.

english: It is as if the God of Love had put a stop to this at the tips of his fingers:" "But let me explain to you what it is like to knit a braid."

english: When I enter the goddess's house I am bound to fall at every step, But when I close my eyes God's finger is still there.

prakrit: भणिया य देवी! एयं खणम्पि हत्थाओ नेव मोत्तव्वं,एयस्स पभावाओ पभवन्ति न खुद्दसत्ताई
english: Say," "O goddess! These trembling hands can never cause death. Either they believe in God or they don't."

prakrit: जिणमन्दिरजत्ताइं कारवियं ताहि राइणा सव्वं,कमलावईवि तत्तो जाया आवन्नसत्तत्ति
english: The victory of the jinn is everything, So are the rivers, The lotuses, So is the rule of nature.

prakrit: सुहसम्पडन्तहियइट्ठवत्थुसुविणीयपरियणजुयाए,अह सत्तमम्मि मासे जाओ देवीए दोहलओ
english: With pleasure, with pleasure, With pleasure and pleasure The pleasures of love Are banished, For in seven months The goddess Jao has performed two miracles.

prakrit: लज्जाए तं कस्सवि जाहे न कहेइ ताव कइयावि,परिहायन्तसरीरा दिट्ठा रन्ना इमं भणिया
english: No one will tell you what it is except the shy girl. The sight of her relatives will make her flee," he said.

english:
Goddess! Why aren't you asking me What makes you feel so good When all I see is your brother's milk? God, I'm so naïve.
वरवारणमारụ̄धा दाणं दिन्ती य अत्थिलोयस्स,तुहउच्छङ्गनिविट्ठा तुमए छत्तं धरन्तेणं	The day the bridegroom shall present his gift To your bride - to - be, O housewife, You have to hold on to the roof Above your bedchamber.

prakrit: अह पवरपट्टहत्थी सिङ्गारिय आणिओ निउत्तेहिं,तत्थारụ̄धो राया देवी उण तस्स उच्छङ्गे
english:
Ah! the palm of a hand Sings loudly, And new shoots come from it. So the goddess Raya's bow Sounds like a banner proclaiming her glory.
उवरि धवलायवत्तं मुत्ताहलरेहिरं सयं रन्ना,धरियं तत्तो विविहं पढन्तथुइपाढनिवहेण	Above the clouds Struggle with the ever - increasing stream of water, Below the rivers diverging in different directions.

english: A sympathetic hand gives alms to the poor as soon as it is full; on the other hand, the spittle of love pierces the navel of no return.

english: I want you to look at me in all sorts of different directions, For, dear girl, The mistletoe on my outside is getting less and less prominent.

english: By standing by one's side, By crossing the street, By talking to the neighbor's wife, By acting in such a way, You have made a mess of the world.

english: Hey! Leigh, Leigh! "He hastened to the place where I am going. There is a begging bowl by the way.

english: In judgment, whatever I say, You withhold, if you do not want to do it," replied the goddess.

english: I will never forget how I fell in love with you, So that when I spoke to you I might repeat my words again.

english: How can I help it! When the lotus opens its mouth And opens its lid, You foolish maniac!"

english: If this is your elephant, then you are a goddess!," Suddenly the elephant touches you as you approach him for help.

english: And when Raya devi is about to be inaugurated, he goes on his way, following the path of good fortune."

english: Life is transient, Death is imminent, The boon of good fortune is great, But waking up in the middle of the night Proves fatal.

english: Men are pure and united, women are generous and kind, men are compassionate and content, and law and dharma are inseparable.

english: Gone is the guinea pig, Gone are the sesame seeds, And gone are the gooseflesh That men shed at the sight of flowers.

english: All are captivated by the beauty of nature, Whether it be gold or silver, Or by the blue sky in which they live.

english: One who does not commit adultery Gives pleasure in a relationship, One who is kind and compassionate Earns respect among others.

english: Far away the fire is burning, The flame is burning hard through the limbs, The fire is drinking - spoiling the fire, The midday sun is shining brightly.

english: Right is a pleasure, wrong is a punishment, right is an ordeal, and so on.

english: Sant, guna, viprasnasa, and non - suffering are one and the same thing; what is human life all about?

english: What do you mean you're not happy? You're angry. But if you can't see him, Who is a good friend?

english: The bee conquers the bitter, the prick the sharp, The husband the cruel, The yokel the content, And discord the indomitable.

english: If you want to be happy, You'd better go with me, For even my body will not forgive me, Not my lover's.

prakrit: कह नाम तस्स पावं चिन्तिज्जइआगऎ विकॊहम्मि,उप्पल-दल-सुकुमालॊ जस्स घरॆओल्लिऒहत्थॊ?
english: What is the name of that tree by which we first thought of it? It looks like a bunch of peacock feathers hanging down from the roof of a house.

english: To drink, To visit, To arrive, To leave, To gather, To depart, To die, Is the arrow that lifts the bow.

english: I am not so stuffy; the fuller the more pleasant; the thinner the five, the more agreeable it is to drink.

prakrit: तॆ धन्ना जॆ धम्मं सुट्ठु वि जाणन्ति सुट्ठु विकरन्ति,जीविय-सारम अ-सारं:खणॆण परियत्तऎ सव्वं
english: Blessed are those who, though they know Dharma properly, still behave properly: The essence of life is immaterial: Everything is perishable by circumcision.

english: That love is what makes one drunk, That friendship is what gives one such ear, That politeness cures one's dharma.

english: Nor does she call him Maya, or her son, or any of her relatives; The Dharma is identical with what men and women perform.

english: How come you're so busy? The diyas flutter like trumpets, They can't count you out, Nor can you count them out.

prakrit: तुट्ठा हॊन्ति मणुस्सा: इन्दमहॊ आगऒ त्ति रमणीऒ;,न वि जाणन्ति वराया: पडिया संवच्छर-सलाया!
english: A man who is broken: The fire is great, And a woman who is lovely - No one knows what a bridegroom is But the bedchamber.
